74963.meaning1: chose to get ordained; decided to become a monastic; asked for ordination
74963.commentary: (SNPa) tatth'eva pabbajjam'arocayitthā'ti tatth'eva ca naṃ āsane nisinnaṃ kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ tisso tāpaso pabbajjam'arocayittha, ayācī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. taṃ bhagavā ehi bhikkhū'ti āha.

examples.text: sutvāna buddhassa subhāsitaṃ padaṃ, nirāmagandhaṃ sabbadukkhappanūdanaṃ, nīcamano vandi tathāgatassa, tatth'eva pabbajjam'arocayitthā'ti.

74964.meaning1: I am yours; I am your friend
74964.commentary: (SNPa) tav'āham'asmi iti bhāsamānan'ti ahaṃ, samma, tava sahāyo hitakāmo sukhakāmo, jīvitam'pi me tuyhaṃ atthāya pariccattan'ti evam'ādinā nayena bhāsamānaṃ. (JAa) tav'āham'asmī'ti tava ahaṃ mitto'ti kevalaṃ vacanamatten'eva bhāsamānaṃ.

examples.text: hiriṃ tarantaṃ vijigucchamānaṃ, tav'āham'asmi iti bhāsamānaṃ, sayhāni kammāni anādiyantaṃ, n'eso maman'ti iti naṃ vijaññā.
hiriṃ tarantaṃ vijigucchamānaṃ, sakh'āham'asmi iti bhāsamānaṃ, sayhāni kammāni anādiyantaṃ, n'eso maman'ti iti naṃ vijaññā.

74966.grammar: prp of na anueti, neg, trans (+acc)
74966.meaning1: not following up; not doing (what one said); not acting accordingly
74966.construction: na > an + anu > anv + aya + nta
74966.commentary: (SNPa) ananvayan'ti yaṃ atthaṃ dassāmi, karissāmī'ti ca bhāsati, tena ananugataṃ.

examples.text: ananvayaṃ piyaṃ vācaṃ, yo mittesu pakubbati, akarontaṃ bhāsamānaṃ, parijānanti paṇḍitā.
samuggatassa jhāyissa, ananugat'antarassa suddhassa, asitassa hitassa, pavivittassa aggappattassa, tiṇṇassa tārayantassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

74968.meaning1: (of friendship) fearing a breakup; suspecting a split; apprehensive about separation
74968.commentary: (SNPa) na so mitto yo sadā appamatto, bhed'āsaṅkī randham'ev'ānupassī'ti yo bhedam'eva āsaṅkamāno katamadhurena upacārena sadā appamatto viharati, yaṃkiñci assatiyā amanasikārena kataṃ, aññāṇakena vā akataṃ, yadā maṃ garahissati, tadā naṃ etena paṭicodessāmī'ti evaṃ randham'eva anupassati, na so mitto sevitabbo'ti. (JAa) bhed'āsaṅkī'ti ajja bhijjissati, sve bhijjissatī'ti evaṃ mittassa bhedam'eva āsaṅkati.

examples.text: na so mitto yo sadā appamatto, bhed'āsaṅkī randham'ev'ānupassī, yasmiñ'ca seti urasī'va putto, sa ve mitto yo parehi abhejjo.

74969.commentary: (SNPa) na so mitto yo sadā appamatto, bhed'āsaṅkī randham'ev'ānupassī'ti yo bhedam'eva āsaṅkamāno katamadhurena upacārena sadā appamatto viharati, yaṃkiñci assatiyā amanasikārena kataṃ, aññāṇakena vā akataṃ, yadā maṃ garahissati, tadā naṃ etena paṭicodessāmī'ti evaṃ randham'eva anupassati, na so mitto sevitabbo'ti.
74969.notes: An unusual use of appamatta with a negative connotation.

examples.text: na so mitto yo sadā appamatto, bhed'āsaṅkī randham'ev'ānupassī, yasmiñ'ca seti urasī'va putto, sa ve mitto yo parehi abhejjo.
pāmujjakaraṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ, pasaṃs'āvahanaṃ sukhaṃ, phal'ānisaṃso bhāveti, vahanto porisaṃ dhuraṃ.

74971.commentary: (SNPa) pasaṃsaṃ āvahatī'ti pasaṃs'āvahanaṃ. ādito dibbamānusakasukhānaṃ, pariyosāne nibbānasukhassa āvahanato phal'ūpacārena sukhaṃ.

examples.text: pāmujjakaraṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ, pasaṃs'āvahanaṃ sukhaṃ, phal'ānisaṃso bhāveti, vahanto porisaṃ dhuraṃ.

74972.meaning1: expecting the results; anticipating the fruit

examples.text: pāmujjakaraṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ, pasaṃs'āvahanaṃ sukhaṃ, phal'ānisaṃso bhāveti, vahanto porisaṃ dhuraṃ.
pāmujjakaraṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ, pasaṃs'āvahanaṃ sukhaṃ, phal'ānisaṃso bhāveti, vahanto porisaṃ dhuraṃ.

74974.meaning1: highest wealth; greatest goodness; (comm) best jewel
74974.commentary: (SNPa) etadāhu vas'uttaman'ti etaṃ ubhayam'pi lokiyalok'uttaraṃ sucaritaṃ saggamokkhasukhasampāpakattā vas'uttaman'ti āhu ariyā. vas'uttamaṃ nāma uttamaratanaṃ, anugāmikaṃ att'ādhīnaṃ rāj'ādīnaṃ asādhāraṇan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: dhammacariyaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, etadāhu vas'uttamaṃ, pabbajito'pi ce hoti, agārā anagāriyaṃ.
so ce mukharajātiko, vihes'ābhirato mago, jīvitaṃ tassa pāpiyo, rajaṃ vaḍḍheti attano.

74976.meaning1: speaking harshly; talking unkindly; using rough words

74977.meaning1: really enjoying annoying; very fond of cruelty

examples.text: so ce mukharajātiko, vihes'ābhirato mago, jīvitaṃ tassa pāpiyo, rajaṃ vaḍḍheti attano.

74978.meaning1: really enjoying arguments; very fond of quarrels; indulging in disputes
74978.commentary: (SNPa) na kevalañ'ca iminā'va kāraṇenassa jīvitaṃ pāpiyo, apica kho pana ayaṃ evarūpo mukharajātikattā kalah'ābhirato bhikkhu

examples.text: kalah'ābhirato bhikkhu, mohadhammena āvuto, akkhātam'pi na jānāti, dhammaṃ buddhena desitaṃ.

74979.grammar: nt, abstr, in comps, from jātika
74979.meaning1: fact of being the type; fact of having a certain nature
74979.construction:
√jan > jā + ti + ka + tta
jātika + tta

74980.grammar: opt 2nd pl of abhinibbajjayati, irreg form of abhinibbajjayeyyātha, trans (+acc)
74980.commentary: (SNPa) abhinibbajjiyāthā'ti vivajjeyyātha mā bhajeyyātha, mā c'assa abhinibbajjanamatten'eva app'ossukkataṃ āpajjeyyātha

examples.text: sabbe samaggā hutvāna, abhinibbajjiyātha naṃ, kāraṇḍavaṃ niddhamatha, kasambuṃ apakassatha.

74982.meaning1: practised for one's own welfare; acted in one's own best interest

examples.text: isayo pubbakā āsuṃ, saññatattā tapassino, pañca kāmaguṇe hitvā, atta'd'attham'acārisuṃ.

74983.meaning1: with recitation as wealth and grain
74983.commentary: (SNPa) te hi nikkhittajātarūparajatā asannidhikārakā'va hutvā kevalaṃ sajjhāya-dhanadhaññā attano mant'ajjhenasaṅkhāten'eva dhanena dhaññena ca samannāgatā ahesuṃ.

examples.text: na pasū brāhmaṇān'āsuṃ, na hiraññaṃ na dhāniyaṃ, sajjhāya-dhanadhañña-āsuṃ, brahmaṃ nidhim'apālayuṃ.

74984.commentary: (SNPa) yo c'āyaṃ mett'ādivihāro seṭṭhattā anugāmikattā ca brahmanidhī'ti vuccati, tañ'ca brahmaṃ nidhim'apālayuṃ sadā tassa bhāvan'ānuyogena.

examples.text: na pasū brāhmaṇān'āsuṃ, na hiraññaṃ na dhāniyaṃ, sajjhāyadhanadhaññ'āsuṃ, brahmaṃ nidhim'apālayuṃ.

74985.meaning1: made with faith; prepared with trust

examples.text: yaṃ nesaṃ pakataṃ āsi, dvārabhattaṃ upaṭṭhitaṃ, saddhāpakatam'esānaṃ, dātave tadamaññisuṃ.

74986.meaning1: to give; to offer; to donate; (comm) to be given

examples.text: yaṃ nesaṃ pakataṃ āsi, dvārabhattaṃ upaṭṭhitaṃ, saddhāpakatam'esānaṃ, dātave tadamaññisuṃ.

74987.commentary: (SNPa) tadamaññisun'ti taṃ amaññiṃsu, taṃ dvāre sajjetvā ṭhapitaṃ bhattaṃ saddhādeyyaṃ pariyesamānānaṃ etesaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ dātabbaṃ amaññiṃsu dāyakā janā, na tato paraṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ nesaṃ pakataṃ āsi, dvārabhattaṃ upaṭṭhitaṃ, saddhāpakatam'esānaṃ, dātave tadamaññisuṃ.

74988.meaning1: household entrance; door of a house

examples.text: avajjhā brāhmaṇā āsuṃ, ajeyyā dhammarakkhitā, na ne koci nivāresi, kuladvāresu sabbaso.

74989.meaning1: search for wisdom and ethical conduct
74989.commentary: (SNPa) evaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carantā eva hi vijjācaraṇapariyeṭṭhiṃ acaruṃ brāhmaṇā pure, na abrahmacārino hutvā. vijjāpariyeṭṭhī'ti mant'ajjhenaṃ. vuttañ'c'etaṃ so aṭṭhacattālīsa vassāni komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno'ti (a. ni. 5.192). caraṇapariyeṭṭhī'ti sīlarakkhaṇaṃ.

examples.text: aṭṭhacattālīsaṃ vassāni, brahmacariyaṃ cariṃsu te, vijjācaraṇapariyeṭṭhiṃ, acaruṃ brāhmaṇā pure.

74990.meaning1: went to another (woman); went to (a woman of) another (caste)
74990.commentary: (SNPa) yathāvuttañ'ca kālaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritvā tato paraṃ ghar'āvāsaṃ kappentā'pi na brāhmaṇā aññam'agamuṃ khattiyaṃ vā vess'ādīsu aññataraṃ vā, ye ahesuṃ devasamā vā mariyādā vā'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: na brāhmaṇā aññam'agamuṃ, na'pi bhariyaṃ kiṇiṃsu te, sampiyen'eva saṃvāsaṃ, saṅgantvā samarocayuṃ.
tassa vattam'anusikkhantā, idh'eke viññujātikā, brahmacariyañ'ca sīlañ'ca, khantiñ'cā'pi avaṇṇayuṃ.

74992.synonym: ñāṇī, dhīra, nipaka, pañña, paññava, paññavant, paññāṇavant, paññāvant, paṇḍita, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññū, sapañña, sappañña

examples.text: tassa vattam'anusikkhantā, idh'eke viññujātikā, brahmacariyañ'ca sīlañ'ca, khantiñ'cā'pi avaṇṇayuṃ.

74993.commentary: (SNPa) sappitelañ'ca yāciya dhammena, uddissa ariyā tiṭṭhanti, esā ariyāna yācanā'ti evaṃ vuttena uddissaṭhānasaṅkhātena dhammena yācitvā

examples.text: taṇḍulaṃ sayanaṃ vatthaṃ, sappitelañ'ca yāciya, dhammena samodhānetvā, tato yaññam'akappayuṃ.

74994.meaning1: arranged the sacrifice; performed the sacrificial offering

examples.text: taṇḍulaṃ sayanaṃ vatthaṃ, sappitelañ'ca yāciya, dhammena samodhānetvā, tato yaññam'akappayuṃ.

74995.commentary: (SNPa) evaṃ te porāṇā brāhmaṇā evarūpā hutvā dassanīyā pasādanīyā lokassa paramadakkhiṇeyyā imāya paṭipattiyā yāva loke avattiṃsu, tāva vigataītibhay'upaddavā hutvā

examples.text: sukhumālā mahākāyā, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, brāhmaṇā sehi dhammehi, kicc'ākiccesu ussukā, yāva loke avattiṃsu, sukham'edhitth'ayaṃ pajā.

74996.commentary: (SNPa) sukhaṃ edhittha pāpuṇi, sukhaṃ vā edhittha sukhaṃ vuḍḍhiṃ agamāsi.

examples.text: sukhumālā mahākāyā, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, brāhmaṇā sehi dhammehi, kicc'ākiccesu ussukā, yāva loke avattiṃsu, sukham'edhitth'ayaṃ pajā.
tesaṃ āsi vipallāso, disvāna aṇuto aṇuṃ, rājino ca viyākāraṃ, nāriyo samalaṅ'katā.
rathe c'ājaññasaṃyutte, sukate cittasibbane, nivesane nivese ca, vibhatte bhāgaso mite.

74999.meaning1: adorned with embroidery; decorated with needlework

examples.text: rathe c'ājaññasaṃyutte, sukate cittasibbane, nivesane nivese ca, vibhatte bhāgaso mite.
yojentu ve rājarathe, sukate cittasibbane, kacchaṃ nāgānaṃ bandhatha, gīveyyaṃ paṭimuñcatha.
